split_policy.primary_axis: tooling/e2e bootstrap readiness behavior before fixture directory label, JSON snapshot, expected report, legacy blocker payload, malformed JSON, hard-fail row, old-mode label, shim label, fallback label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: bootstrap readiness positives are limited to hand-authored readiness scenarios owned by the e2e/tooling owner; parser, sema, lowering, IR, and runtime phases get no positive compiler behavior from this fixture family
split_policy.canonical_rejection_rule: legacy blocker array payloads, compatibility-shaped blocker rows, old-mode readiness rows, shim/fallback rows, generated-only rows, report-only rows, migration-only rows, wrapper-only rows, and directory-label-only claims are non-positive rejection or provenance evidence
split_policy.strict_error_rule: malformed JSON and hard_fail_* open-blocker metadata scenarios own fail-closed strict errors and cannot be cited as positive readiness support
split_policy.provenance_rule: issues, milestones, catalog, open blockers, expected JSON, expected markdown, expected stderr, and expected exit-code files are fixture provenance unless the e2e/tooling owner claims the scenario boundary
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode bootstrap, compatibility bootstrap, shim bootstrap, fallback bootstrap, legacy blocker payload support, generated-only bootstrap, report-only bootstrap, migration-only bootstrap, wrapper-only bootstrap, runner-only success, workflow-label-only success, and generated/report rows promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
